title: Morning Greeting to Creation & Good of Day
arabicText: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ فَتْحَهُ وَنَصْرَهُ وَنُورَهُ وَبَرَكَتَهُ وَهُدَاهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillahi Rabbil-alamin. Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhal-yawmi fathahu wa nasrahu wa nurahu wa barakatahu wa hudahu, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fihi wa sharri ma badahu.
translation: We have reached the morning and sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of all worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day and seek refuge from its evil.
virtueOrContext: Morning plea asking Allah to unlock every blessing in the day ahead.

title: Attributing Morning Blessings Solely to Allah
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
transliteration: Allahumma ma asbaha bi min nimatin aw bi-ahadin min khalqika fa-minka wahdaka la sharika laka, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr.
translation: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me or any of Your creation this morning is from You alone without partner, so for You is all praise and gratitude.
virtueOrContext: Whoever says this in the morning has fulfilled his gratitude for the day.

title: Attributing Evening Blessings Solely to Allah
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
transliteration: Allahumma ma amsa bi min nimatin aw bi-ahadin min khalqika fa-minka wahdaka la sharika laka, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr.
translation: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me or any of Your creation this evening is from You alone without partner, so to You belongs all praise and gratitude.
virtueOrContext: Whoever recites this in the evening fulfills their gratitude for the night.

title: Morning Affirmation of Allah's Sight & Witness
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni asbahtu ushhiduka wa ushhidu hamalata arshika wa mala'ikataka wa jami'a khalqika annaka AntAllahu la ilaha illa Anta wahdaka la sharika laka wa anna Muhammadan abduka wa rasuluk.
translation: O Allah, this morning I call You, Your angels, and all creation to witness that You are Allah alone and Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger.
virtueOrContext: Recited four times morning and evening for emancipation from the Fire.

title: Dhikr Surpassing Hours of Remembrance
arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: La ilaha illAllahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa ala kulli shay'in Qadir.
translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone without partner; to Him belongs dominion and praise, and He has power over everything.
virtueOrContext: Recited ten times (or 100 times) daily for immense reward and protection against Shaytan.

title: Salawat Ten Times Morning & Evening
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim ala nabiyyina Muhammad.
translation: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
virtueOrContext: Recited 10 times morning and evening to earn intercession of the Prophet.

title: Seeking Wellbeing in Body, Hearing & Sight
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma afini fi badani, Allahumma afini fi sam'i, Allahumma afini fi basari, la ilaha illa Anta.
translation: O Allah, grant me health in my body, health in my hearing, and health in my sight. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
virtueOrContext: Recited three times morning and evening for bodily and sensory soundness.

title: Seeking Afiyah in Religion, World, Family & Wealth
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-afwa wal-afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal-afwa wal-afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali.
translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the Hereafter, and in my religion, worldly affairs, family, and wealth.
virtueOrContext: Never abandoned by the Prophet either in morning or evening.

title: HasbiyAllahu Seven Times Morning & Evening
arabicText: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: HasbiyAllahu la ilaha illa Huwa, alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul-arshil-azim.
translation: Sufficient for me is Allah; none has the right to be worshipped except Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is Lord of the Mighty Throne.
virtueOrContext: Recited seven times morning and evening; Allah suffices whatever worries you.

title: Al-Mu'awwidhat Morning & Evening Shield
arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
transliteration: Qul HuwAllahu Ahad, Qul a'udhu biRabbil-Falaq, Qul a'udhu biRabbin-Nas.
translation: Recite Surahs Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas three times each.
virtueOrContext: Three times morning and evening suffices the believer as a shield from everything.

title: Protection From Evil of What I Have Done
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bini'matika alayya wa abu'u laka bidhanbi faghfir li fa-innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa Anta.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and confess my sin, so forgive me.
virtueOrContext: Part of Sayyid al-Istighfar promising Paradise when recited with conviction.

title: Seeking Protection Before Sunrise & Sunset
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa Huwas-Sami'ul-Alim.
translation: In the Name of Allah with whose Name nothing in the earth or heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
virtueOrContext: Recited three times morning and evening; prevents sudden affliction.

title: Asking Steadfastness in Religion & Life
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الثَّبَاتَ فِي الْأَمْرِ وَالْعَزِيمَةَ عَلَى الرُّشْدِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukath-thabata fil-amri wal-azimata alar-rushd.
translation: O Allah, I ask You for steadfastness in every matter and determination upon the right path.
virtueOrContext: Prophetic supplication for firmness in daily devotion.

title: Waking Up in the Night and Turning Over
arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ
transliteration: La ilaha illAllahul-Wahidul-Qahhar, Rabbus-samawati wal-ardi wa ma baynahumal-Azizul-Ghaffar.
translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, the One, the Subduer, Lord of the heavens and earth and all between them, the Exalted, the Forgiver.
virtueOrContext: Recited when turning from side to side during sleep at night.

title: Waking Up Sudden Fright or Restlessness
arabicText: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min ghadabihi wa iqabihi wa sharri ibadihi wa min hamazatish-shayatini wa an yahdurun.
translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger, punishment, the evil of His servants, and the whisperings of devils.
virtueOrContext: Taught by the Prophet to calm fear or nightmares during sleep.

title: Waking Up at Night Seeking Forgiveness
arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
transliteration: La ilaha illAllahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa ala kulli shay'in Qadir. SubhanAllahi wal-hamdulillahi wa la ilaha illAllahu wAllahu Akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. Allahummaghfir li.
translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone; glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no power nor strength except by Allah. O Allah, forgive me.
virtueOrContext: Whoever wakes at night and says this and then makes dua will have it answered.

title: Surrendering Soul and Turning Back Before Sleep
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilayk, wa alja'tu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk. Amantu bikitabikal-ladhi anzalta wa binabiyyikal-ladhi arsalt.
translation: O Allah, I submit my soul to You, entrust my affair to You, turn my face to You, and rely upon You in hope and awe. I believe in Your Book and Your Prophet.
virtueOrContext: Make these the last words before sleeping; if one passes that night, they die upon the pure fitrah.

title: Protection From Day of Resurrection When Sleeping
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
transliteration: Allahumma qini adhabaka yawma tab'athu ibadak.
translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
virtueOrContext: Said three times while placing the right hand beneath the right cheek before sleep.

title: Lord of the Seven Heavens Before Lying Down
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ
transliteration: Allahumma Rabbas-samawatis-sab'i wa Rabbal-arshil-azim, Rabbana wa Rabba kulli shay', faliqal-habbi wan-nawa wa munzilat-Tawrati wal-Injili wal-Furqan, a'udhu bika min sharri kulli shay'in Anta akhidhun binasiyatih.
translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Mighty Throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of grain and date-stone, Revealer of Scripture, I seek refuge from all evil.
virtueOrContext: Comprehensive bedtime supplication acknowledging Allah's sovereignty.

title: Praise Upon Having Sufficiency and Shelter at Night
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لَا كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلَا مُؤْوِيَ
transliteration: Alhamdulillahi-lladhi at'amana wa saqana wa kafana wa awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wa la mu'wiya.
translation: All praise is to Allah who fed us, gave us drink, sufficed us, and sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice or shelter them.
virtueOrContext: Spoken by the Prophet whenever retiring to bed.

title: Tasbih Fatimah Before Sleeping (33-33-34)
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (٣٣) وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣) وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤)
transliteration: SubhanAllah (33x), Alhamdulillah (33x), Allahu Akbar (34x).
translation: Glory be to Allah (33 times), Praise be to Allah (33 times), Allah is Most Great (34 times).
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 3705 • Sahih Muslim 2727 • Hisn al-Muslim 107
virtueOrContext: Taught to Fatimah and Ali as a source of strength.

title: Laying Down in the Name of Allah
arabicText: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
transliteration: Bismika Rabbi wada'tu janbi wa bika arfa'uhu, fa-in amsakta nafsi farhamha wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi ibadakas-salihin.
translation: In Your Name my Lord, I lay my side down and in Your Name I raise it. If You take my soul then have mercy on it, and if You return it then protect it.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6320 • Sahih Muslim 2714 • Hisn al-Muslim 103
virtueOrContext: Sunnah upon lying on the right side after dusting the bed.

title: Praise Upon Awakening With Life & Sight Restored
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
transliteration: Alhamdulillahi-lladhi afani fi jasadi, wa radda alayya ruhi, wa adhina li bidhikrih.
translation: All praise is to Allah who healed my body, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.
virtueOrContext: Spoken upon opening one's eyes at dawn.

title: Last Two Ayahs of Surah Al-Baqarah Before Bed
arabicText: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ...
transliteration: Amanar-Rasulu bima unzila ilayhi mir-Rabbihi wal-mu'minun... (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:285-286)
translation: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers...
virtueOrContext: Whoever recites the last two verses of Al-Baqarah at night, they suffice him.

title: Action Upon Seeing a Disliked Dream
arabicText: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا رَأَيْتُ
transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim wa min sharri ma ra'ayt.
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil and from the evil of what I have seen.
virtueOrContext: Seek refuge three times, lightly blow left, change sides, and do not relate bad dreams.

title: Surah Al-Ikhlas & Mu'awwidhat Into Cupped Palms Before Sleep
arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
transliteration: Recite Surahs 112, 113, and 114 into cupped palms, lightly blow, and wipe over the body three times.
translation: Blow gently into cupped hands, recite the Three Quls, and wipe head, face, and front of body three times.
virtueOrContext: Every night when retiring to bed, the Prophet performed this three-fold protection.

title: Placing Hand on Area of Pain & Saying Bismillah
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (٣) أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ (٧)
transliteration: Bismillah (3x), A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir (7x).
translation: In the Name of Allah (3 times). I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I find and fear (7 times).
virtueOrContext: Place right hand over any painful spot on the body and recite.

title: Adhhibil-Ba's Rabban-Nas Complete Cure
arabicText: أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ اشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
transliteration: Adhhibil-ba'sa Rabban-nas, ishfi wa Antash-Shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uka, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama.
translation: Remove the hardship, O Lord of mankind, and grant healing for You are the Healer; there is no cure except Your cure—a cure that leaves behind no illness.
virtueOrContext: Recited while wiping gently over a sick person.

title: Seven Times Visiting a Sick Believer
arabicText: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
transliteration: As'alullahal-Azim, Rabbal-arshil-azim an yashfiyak.
translation: I ask Allah the Supreme, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal you.
virtueOrContext: Recite seven times when visiting an ill person whose appointed hour has not arrived.

title: Jibreel's Ruqyah Over the Prophet
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنٍ حَاسِدٍ اللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ
transliteration: Bismillahi arqika min kulli shay'in yu'dhika, min sharri kulli nafsin aw aynin hasidin, Allahu yashfika, Bismillahi arqik.
translation: In the Name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you from everything that harms you, from every soul or envious eye. May Allah heal you.
virtueOrContext: Recited by Jibreel when the Prophet experienced illness.

title: Seeking Cure Through the Sacred Soil of Earth
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تُرْبَةُ أَرْضِنَا بِرِيقَةِ بَعْضِنَا يُشْفَى سَقِيمُنَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّنَا
transliteration: Bismillahi turbatu ardina biriqati ba'dina, yushfa saqimuna bi-idhni Rabbina.
translation: In the Name of Allah, the dust of our land mixed with the moisture of some of us, by it our sick is healed by the permission of our Lord.
virtueOrContext: Prophetic ruqyah for minor wounds and fevers.

title: La Ba'sa Tahurun InshaAllah
arabicText: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
transliteration: La ba'sa tahurun in sha'Allah.
translation: No harm; it will be a purification (from sins), if Allah wills.
virtueOrContext: Gentle words of comfort spoken when visiting the ill.

title: Dua When Illness Becomes Overwhelming
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْيِنِي مَا كَانَتِ الْحَيَاةُ خَيْرًا لِي وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا كَانَتِ الْوَفَاةُ خَيْرًا لِي
transliteration: Allahumma ahyini ma kanatil-hayatu khayran li, wa tawaffani idha kanatil-wafatu khayran li.
translation: O Allah, keep me alive so long as life is better for me, and take my soul when death is better for me.
virtueOrContext: Taught instead of ever wishing for death during severe suffering.

title: Dua for Relief at the Time of Approaching Death
arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ إِنَّ لِلْمَوْتِ سَكَرَاتٍ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى
transliteration: La ilaha illAllahu inna lil-mawti sakarat. Allahummaghfir li warhamni wa alhiqni bir-Rafiqil-A'la.
translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah; indeed death has its agonies. O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, and join me with the Highest Companion.
virtueOrContext: The final documented supplication of the Prophet before passing.

title: Cooling Fever With Remembrance & Supplication
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الْكَبِيرِ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ عِرْقٍ نَعَّارٍ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَرِّ النَّارِ
transliteration: Bismillahil-Kabir, a'udhu billahil-Azim min sharri kulli irqin na'arin wa min sharri harrin-nar.
translation: In the Name of Allah the Great, I seek refuge in Allah the Supreme from the evil of every throbbing vein and from the evil heat of fire.
virtueOrContext: Reported in Sunan At-Tirmidhi for relief from fever and inflammation.

title: Seeking Blessing (Tabrik) So Evil Eye Cannot Harm
arabicText: مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ فِيهِ
transliteration: Ma sha'Allahu la quwwata illa billah. Allahumma barik fih.
translation: What Allah wills! There is no power except by Allah. O Allah, bless it for them.
virtueOrContext: Said whenever admiring a child, home, or blessing of another believer.

title: Ayyub's Quranic Cry in Chronic Illness
arabicText: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
transliteration: Anni massaniyad-durru wa Anta Arhamur-rahimin.
translation: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
virtueOrContext: Prophet Ayyub's humble prayer answered with complete restoration and mercy.

title: Protection of Children (Dua for Hasan & Husayn)
arabicText: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
transliteration: U'idhukuma bikalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammah, wa min kulli aynin lammah.
translation: I place you both under the protection of the perfect words of Allah from every devil, poisonous creature, and harmful eye.
virtueOrContext: Used by Prophet Ibrahim and Prophet Muhammad for protecting children.

title: Before Performing Wudu (Ablution)
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillah.
translation: In the Name of Allah.
virtueOrContext: Spoken upon beginning ablution (wudu).

title: Upon Completing Wudu (Shahadah & Purity)
arabicText: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illAllahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh. Allahummaj'alni minat-tawwabina waj'alni minal-mutatahhirin.
translation: I bear witness that none is worthy of worship but Allah alone and Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah, make me among those who constantly repent and purify themselves.
virtueOrContext: Opens all eight gates of Paradise for whoever says it after wudu.

title: Opening Supplication of Salah (Istiftah)
arabicText: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
transliteration: SubhanakAllahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabarakasmuka, wa ta'ala jadduka, wa la ilaha ghayruk.
translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise; blessed is Your Name, exalted is Your Majesty, and there is none worthy of worship besides You.
virtueOrContext: Recited quietly after Takbirat al-Ihram before Al-Fatihah.

title: Dua Seeking Distance Between Oneself & Sins (Istiftah)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ
transliteration: Allahumma ba'id bayni wa bayna khatayaya kama ba'adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib; Allahumma naqqini min khatayaya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas.
translation: O Allah, distance me from my sins just as You distanced the East from the West; purify me from my faults as a white garment is purified from stain.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 744 • Sahih Muslim 598 • Hisn al-Muslim 27
virtueOrContext: Opening supplication taught by the Prophet in obligatory prayer.

title: Dua in Ruku (Bowing) Glorifying Allah
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ (٣) سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
transliteration: Subhana Rabbiyal-Azim (3x). Subbuhun Quddusun, Rabbul-mala'ikati war-Ruh.
translation: Glory be to my Lord the Supreme (3 times). Most Glorious, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
virtueOrContext: Recited in bowing (Ruku) during prayer.

title: Upon Rising From Ruku (Rabbana wa Lakal-Hamd)
arabicText: سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ۝ رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ
transliteration: Sami'Allahu liman hamidah. Rabbana wa lakal-hamd, hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih.
translation: Allah hears whoever praises Him. Our Lord, to You belongs all praise—abundant, pure, and blessed praise.
virtueOrContext: Angels competed over thirty of them to record these words first.

title: Dua in Sujud (Prostration)
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى (٣) اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
transliteration: Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la (3x). Allahummaghfir li dhanbi kullahu diqqahu wa jillahu wa awwalahu wa akhirahu wa alaniyatahu wa sirrah.
translation: Glory be to my Lord the Most High (3 times). O Allah, forgive all my sins—small and great, first and last, open and secret.
virtueOrContext: The closest a servant gets to Allah is during prostration; increase dua here.

title: Sitting Between the Two Prostrations (Jalsah)
arabicText: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَاجْبُرْنِي وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي وَارْفَعْنِي
transliteration: Rabbighfir li, Rabbighfir li. Allahummaghfir li warhamni wahdini wajburni wa afini warzuqni warfa'ni.
translation: My Lord, forgive me! O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, mend me, grant me wellness, provide for me, and elevate me.
reference: Abu Dawud 850 • Ibn Majah 898 • Hisn al-Muslim 48-49 (Sahih)
virtueOrContext: Comprehensive seven-fold petition between the two sajdahs.

title: Tashahhud (At-Tahiyyat)
arabicText: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
transliteration: At-tahiyyatu lillahi was-salawatu wat-tayyibat. As-salamu alayka ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh. As-salamu alayna wa ala ibadillahis-salihin. Ashhadu an la ilaha illAllahu wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh.
translation: All compliments, prayers, and pure words belong to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy and blessings of Allah. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 831 • Sahih Muslim 402 • Hisn al-Muslim 51
virtueOrContext: Recited in the sitting posture of prayer.

title: As-Salat Al-Ibrahimiyyah (Durood Ibrahim)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammadin kama sallayta ala Ibrahima wa ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidun Majid. Allahumma barik ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammadin kama barakta ala Ibrahima wa ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidun Majid.
translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and his family. And bless them as You blessed Ibrahim and his family.
virtueOrContext: Best and most authentic form of Durood after Tashahhud.

title: Four Protections Before Closing Salah (After Tashahhud)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min adhabi Jahannam, wa min adhabil-qabr, wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat, wa min sharri fitnatil-Masihid-Dajjal.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hellfire, punishment of the grave, trials of life and death, and the evil trial of the False Messiah.
virtueOrContext: Strongly emphasized before saying Salam at the end of prayer.

title: Abu Bakr's Dua Before Salam
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa Anta, faghfir li maghfiratan min indika warhamni, innaka Antal-Ghafurur-Rahim.
translation: O Allah, I have wronged myself exceedingly and none forgives sins except You, so forgive me and have mercy on me; You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 834 • Sahih Muslim 2705 • Hisn al-Muslim 57
virtueOrContext: Specifically taught by the Prophet to Abu Bakr as-Siddiq to say in prayer.

title: Dua After Salam (Ayat al-Kursi & Istighfar)
arabicText: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (٣) اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
transliteration: Astaghfirullah (3x). Allahumma Antas-Salamu wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram.
translation: I seek Allah's forgiveness (3 times). O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace; blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.
virtueOrContext: The very first words spoken immediately after concluding obligatory prayer.

title: Mu'adh's Reminder After Every Prayer
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma a'inni ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni ibadatik.
translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to give thanks to You, and to worship You in the best manner.
virtueOrContext: Urged by the Prophet to be recited after every obligatory prayer.

title: Qunut of Witr Prayer
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ
transliteration: Allahummahdini fiman hadayt, wa afini fiman afayt, wa tawallani fiman tawallayt, wa barik li fima a'tayt, wa qini sharra ma qadayt.
translation: O Allah, guide me among those You guided, grant wellness among those You granted wellness, take me as ally, bless what You gave, and protect me from evil decree.
virtueOrContext: Taught by the Prophet to Al-Hasan ibn Ali for Witr Qunut.

title: Dua Immediately After Witr Prayer
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ (٣) رَبِّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
transliteration: Subhanal-Malikil-Quddus (3x), Rabbil-mala'ikati war-Ruh.
translation: Glory be to the Sovereign, the Most Holy (3 times), Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
virtueOrContext: Recited three times after completing Witr, raising the voice on the third.

title: Dua for Istikharah (Seeking Allah's Guidance)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi-ilmika wa astaqdiruka biqudratika wa as'aluka min fadlikal-azim, fa-innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lam, wa Anta Allamul-ghuyub.
translation: O Allah, I seek Your counsel by Your knowledge and power, and ask You from Your immense favor; for You decree and I do not, and You are Knower of the unseen.
virtueOrContext: Pray two rak'ahs then recite when making important life decisions.

title: Dua of Sujud At-Tilawah (Prostration of Recitation)
arabicText: سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ
transliteration: Sajada wajhiya lilladhi khalaqahu wa shaqqa sam'ahu wa basarahu bihawlihi wa quwwatihi, fatabarakAllahu Ahsanul-khaliqin.
translation: My face has prostrated to the One who created it and fashioned its hearing and sight through His strength; blessed is Allah, the Best of creators.
virtueOrContext: Recited when prostrating upon reciting a Sajdah Ayah in the Quran.

title: Entering the Masjid (Plea for Gates of Mercy)
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
transliteration: Bismillahi was-salatu was-salamu ala Rasulillah. Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik.
translation: In the Name of Allah, and peace and blessings upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
reference: Sahih Muslim 713 • Ibn Majah 771 • Hisn al-Muslim 21
virtueOrContext: Stepping into the mosque with the right foot first.

title: Leaving the Masjid (Plea for Allah's Bounty)
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
transliteration: Bismillahi was-salatu was-salamu ala Rasulillah. Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik.
translation: In the Name of Allah, and peace and blessings upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, indeed I ask You from Your bounty.
virtueOrContext: Stepping out of the mosque with the left foot first.

title: Dua After Hearing the Adhan
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
transliteration: Allahumma Rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammati was-salatil-qa'imah, ati Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilata wab'athhu maqaman mahmudanil-ladhi wa'adtah.
translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad Al-Wasilah and eminence, and raise him to the praised station You promised him.
virtueOrContext: Guarantees the Prophet's intercession on the Day of Resurrection.

title: Dua Upon Hearing the Mu'adhin Say Ashhadu
arabicText: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولًا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا
transliteration: Raditu billahi Rabban, wa bi Muhammadin rasulan, wa bil-Islami dinan.
translation: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Muhammad as Messenger, and with Islam as my religion.
virtueOrContext: Recited during the Adhan after the testimonies; earns forgiveness of sins.

title: Walking to the Masjid Seeking Light (Nur)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُورًا وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُورًا
transliteration: Allahummaj'al fi qalbi nuran, wa fi lisani nuran, wa fi sam'i nuran, wa fi basari nuran, wa min fawqi nuran, wa min tahti nuran, wa an yamini nuran, wa an shimali nuran, wa a'zim li nura.
translation: O Allah, place light in my heart, on my tongue, in my hearing, in my sight, above me, below me, to my right, to my left, and magnify light for me.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6316 • Sahih Muslim 763 • Hisn al-Muslim 20
virtueOrContext: Recited by the Prophet while walking to Fajr prayer.

title: Leaving Home in Trust Upon Allah
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu alAllahi, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
translation: In the Name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah; there is no power or strength except through Allah.
virtueOrContext: Said when exiting one's door for guidance and protection.

title: Prophetic Dua for Deep Grief & Distress (Al-Kurb)
arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
transliteration: La ilaha illAllahul-Azimul-Halim, la ilaha illAllahu Rabbul-arshil-azim, la ilaha illAllahu Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-arshil-karim.
translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah the Supreme, the Forbearing; Lord of the Mighty Throne, and Lord of the heavens and earth.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6346 • Sahih Muslim 2730 • Hisn al-Muslim 125
virtueOrContext: Regularly said by the Prophet during times of acute distress.

title: Removing Anxiety & Turning Sorrow Into Joy
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي وَنُورَ صَدْرِي وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
transliteration: Allahumma inni abduka, ibnu abdika, ibnu amatik, nasiyati biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuk, adlun fiyya qada'uk. As'aluka bikulli ismin Huwa lak... an taj'alal-Qur'ana rabi'a qalbi, wa nura sadri, wa jala'a huzni, wa dhahaba hammi.
translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, my forelock is in Your hand. Make the Quran the springtime of my heart, light of my chest, clearing of my sorrow, and departure of my anxiety.
virtueOrContext: Allah removes sorrow and replaces it with relief for whoever says it sincerely.

title: Dua of Distress: Allah Is My Lord, No Partner
arabicText: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
transliteration: Allahu, Allahu Rabbi la ushriku bihi shay'a.
translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord; I do not associate anything as a partner with Him.
reference: Abu Dawud 1525 • Ibn Majah 3882 • Hisn al-Muslim 127 (Sahih)
virtueOrContext: Taught by the Prophet to Asma bint Umays for moments of hardship.

title: No Ease Except What You Make Easy
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahlan, wa Anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahlan.
translation: O Allah, there is no ease except in what You make easy, and You make even difficulty easy whenever You will.
virtueOrContext: Recited before difficult tasks, exams, or stressful obligations.

title: Yunus's Cry From the Depths (La Ilaha Illa Anta)
arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: La ilaha illa Anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You! Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
virtueOrContext: No Muslim calls upon Allah with these words for any matter except that Allah responds.

title: Seeking Allah's Mercy Without Abandonment
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arju fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata aynin wa aslih li sha'ni kullahu, la ilaha illa Anta.
translation: O Allah, it is Your mercy I hope for, so do not leave me to myself for a blink of an eye, and set right all of my affairs.
virtueOrContext: Recited by the distressed believer seeking inner steadiness.

title: HasbunAllahu Wa Ni'mal-Wakil Upon Adversity
arabicText: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
transliteration: HasbunAllahu wa ni'mal-Wakil.
translation: Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
virtueOrContext: Spoken by Prophet Ibrahim and by the Prophet in moments of grave trial.

title: Istirja Upon Any Sudden Calamity or Loss
arabicText: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. Allahummajurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha.
translation: Indeed we belong to Allah and to Him we return. O Allah, reward me in my calamity and replace it with something better for me.
virtueOrContext: Said upon bereavement or any worldly loss; Allah grants something better in return.

title: Refuge From Worry, Sadness, Laziness & Cowardice
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, helplessness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, debt, and being overpowered by men.
virtueOrContext: Frequently recited by the Prophet for relief from emotional and financial burden.

title: Refuge From Sudden Calamity & Malicious Joy of Enemies
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ وَسُوءِ الْقَضَاءِ وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min jahdil-bala'i wa darakish-shaqa'i wa su'il-qada'i wa shamatatil-a'da'.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from severe calamity, descending misery, evil outcome of decree, and the gloating of enemies.
virtueOrContext: Four severe trials the Messenger of Allah specifically urged seeking refuge from.

title: When Surprised by Any Unforeseen Turn of Decree
arabicText: قَدَرُ اللَّهِ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
transliteration: Qadarullahi wa ma sha'a fa'al.
translation: It is the decree of Allah, and whatever He wills, He does.
virtueOrContext: Closes the door to futile 'if only' regret and restores peace in Qadr.

title: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum — Seeking Complete Steadfastness
arabicText: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, bi-rahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullahu wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn.
translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, in Your mercy I seek relief; rectify all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
virtueOrContext: Taught by the Prophet to Fatimah (RA) for total reliance upon Allah in distress and daily life.

title: La Ilaha Illa Anta Subhanaka — Dua of Prophet Yunus
arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: La ilaha illa Anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
virtueOrContext: No Muslim supplicates with these words in any distress except that Allah answers them.

title: When Facing an Overwhelming Task or Complex Obstacle
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla, wa Anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahla.
translation: O Allah, there is no ease except what You make easy, and You make the rough terrain easy whenever You will.
virtueOrContext: Recited before exams, difficult decisions, or overwhelming duties to ask Allah for ease.

title: Prophetic Seeking of Pardon After Every Gathering
arabicText: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
transliteration: SubhanakAllahumma wa bihamdika, ashhadu alla ilaha illa Anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk.
translation: Glory and praise be to You, O Allah. I bear witness there is none worthy of worship except You; I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
virtueOrContext: Expiates idle speech spoken during a sitting (Kaffaratul-Majlis).

title: Master Supplication for Forgiveness (Sayyidul-Istighfar)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma Anta Rabbi la ilaha illa Anta, khalaqtani wa ana abduka wa ana ala ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bini'matika alayya wa abu'u bidhanbi faghfir li, fa-innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa Anta.
translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped but You. You created me and I am Your servant... forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
virtueOrContext: Recited with conviction morning and evening; promised Paradise for those who pass away in that state.

title: Comprehensive Istighfar for Sins Known & Unknown
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي وَجَهْلِي وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي جِدِّي وَهَزْلِي وَخَطَئِي وَعَمْدِي وَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ عِنْدِي
transliteration: Allahummaghfir li khati'ati wa jahli wa israfi fi amri wa ma Anta a'lamu bihi minni. Allahummaghfir li jiddi wa hazli wa khata'i wa amdi wa kullu dhalika indi.
translation: O Allah, forgive my sin, my ignorance, my excess in my affairs, and all that You know better than I. Forgive my seriousness and jest, my error and deliberate faults.
virtueOrContext: A profound Prophetic confession leaving no category of shortcoming unaddressed.

title: Seeking Forgiveness a Hundred Times Daily
arabicText: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
transliteration: Astaghfirullahal-'Azimalladhi la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyumu wa atubu ilayh.
translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Almighty, beside Whom there is no deity, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I turn to Him in repentance.
virtueOrContext: Sins are forgiven by Allah through sincere utterance of this grand Istighfar.

title: Purification From Sins Like Snow & Hail
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَايَ بِمَاءِ الثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّ قَلْبِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ
transliteration: Allahummaghsil khatayaya bima'ith-thalji wal-barad, wa naqqi qalbi minal-khataya kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas.
translation: O Allah, wash away my sins with water of snow and hail, and cleanse my heart of sins just as a white garment is cleansed of stain.
virtueOrContext: Recited in opening of Salah and private repentance for inner spiritual cooling and purity.

title: Asking Allah for Guidance, Piety & Chastity
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-huda wat-tuqa wal-'afafa wal-ghina.
translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, God-consciousness, chastity, and self-sufficiency.
virtueOrContext: A concise four-pillar Prophetic prayer uniting heart, morals, and independence.

title: Dua for Accepting Tawbah & Answering Calls
arabicText: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbighfir li wa tub alayya innaka Antat-Tawwabur-Rahim.
translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance; indeed, You are the Acceptor of Repentance, the Most Merciful.
virtueOrContext: Companions counted the Prophet reciting this a hundred times in a single gathering.

title: Asking Pardon for What Preceded and What Remains
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي
transliteration: Allahummaghfir li ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhartu, wa ma asrartu wa ma a'lantu, wa ma asraftu wa ma Anta a'lamu bihi minni.
translation: O Allah, forgive me for what I have sent ahead and delayed, what I concealed and disclosed, my excesses, and what You know better than I.
virtueOrContext: Concluding supplication taught by the Prophet before finishing Tashahhud.

title: Seeking Refuge From Evil Desires & Bad Character
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مُنْكَرَاتِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالْأَعْمَالِ وَالْأَهْوَاءِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min munkaratil-akhlaqi wal-a'mali wal-ahwa'.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disapproved manners, evil deeds, and misguided desires.
virtueOrContext: Protects both outward conduct and inward inclination from corruption.

title: Laylatul-Qadr Pardon Supplication
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
transliteration: Allahumma innaka Afuwwun tuhibbul-afwa fa'fu anni.
translation: O Allah, You are All-Pardoning and love to pardon, so pardon me.
virtueOrContext: Specifically taught to Aishah (RA) for Ramadan nights and every moment seeking complete erasure of sin.

title: Steadfast Heart Upon the Religion of Allah
arabicText: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
transliteration: Ya Muqallibal-qulubi thabbit qalbi ala dinik.
translation: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.
virtueOrContext: The supplication most frequently recited by the Messenger of Allah.

title: Directing Hearts Toward Complete Obedience
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma Musarrifal-qulubi sarrif qulubana ala ta'atik.
translation: O Allah, Director of hearts, direct our hearts toward Your obedience.
virtueOrContext: Asks Allah to align our love and willpower smoothly toward righteous deeds.

title: Leaving Home With Trust in Allah
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu alAllah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah; there is no might nor power except through Allah.
virtueOrContext: Whoever says this upon leaving is told: You are guided, defended, and protected, and Shaytan withdraws.

title: Seeking Protection Upon Exiting the House
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ أَوْ أَزِلَّ أَوْ أُزَلَّ أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika an adilla aw udall, aw azilla aw uzall, aw azlima aw uzlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala alayya.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I misguide or be misguided, slip or be made to slip, oppress or be oppressed, act foolishly or be treated foolishly.
virtueOrContext: Recited by the Prophet every single time he stepped outside his home.

title: Entering the Masjid With Salutation
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
transliteration: Bismillahi was-salatu was-salamu ala Rasulillah. Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik.
translation: In the name of Allah, and peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
virtueOrContext: Spoken when stepping into the Masjid with the right foot.

title: Leaving the Masjid Seeking Allah's Bounty
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
transliteration: Bismillahi was-salatu was-salamu ala Rasulillah. Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik, Allahumma'simni minash-Shaytanir-rajim.
translation: In the name of Allah, and peace and blessings upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty and ask You to guard me from the accursed Shaytan.
reference: Sahih Muslim 713 • Sunan Ibn Majah 773 • Hisn al-Muslim 20
virtueOrContext: Spoken when stepping out of the Masjid with the left foot to return to daily work.

title: Riding a Vehicle or Starting Any Journey
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
transliteration: Subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun.
translation: Glory be to Him Who subjected this for us, for we could never have subdued it ourselves, and surely to our Lord we shall return.
virtueOrContext: Recited after Bismillah and Alhamdulillah three times and Allahu Akbar three times when boarding transport.

title: Complete Journey Supplication (Dua as-Safar)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ
transliteration: Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa wa minal-amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin alayna safarana hadha watwi anna bu'dah. Allahumma Antas-sahibu fis-safari wal-khalifatu fil-ahl.
translation: O Allah, we ask You in this journey of ours for righteousness, piety, and deeds pleasing to You. Make our journey easy and shorten its distance. You are our Companion in travel and Guardian over our family.
virtueOrContext: Full Sunnah travel supplication entrusting both the traveler and family at home to Allah.

title: Returning Home Safely From Travel
arabicText: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
transliteration: Ayibuna ta'ibuna abiduna li-Rabbina hamidun.
translation: Returning safely, repentant, worshipping, and praising our Lord.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 1797 • Sahih Muslim 1342 • Hisn al-Muslim 216
virtueOrContext: Chanted by the Prophet whenever returning to Madinah from a journey.

title: Entering a New City, Town or Village
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ وَرَبَّ الْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا
transliteration: Allahumma Rabbas-samawatis-sab'i wa ma azlalna wa Rabbal-aradinas-sab'i wa ma aqlalna, as'aluka khayra hadhihil-qaryati wa khayra ahliha wa khayra ma fiha, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ahliha.
translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all they shade, Lord of the seven earths and all they carry, I ask You for the good of this town, its people, and all within it, and seek refuge from its evil.
virtueOrContext: Recited when arriving in any town, airport, or new neighborhood.

title: Entering the Market or Commercial Center
arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: La ilaha illAllahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu wa Huwa Hayyun la yamut, biyadihil-khayru wa Huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir.
translation: None is worthy of worship but Allah alone without partner; to Him belongs dominion and praise; He gives life and causes death while He is Ever-Living and never dies; in His hand is all good and He is Powerful over all things.
virtueOrContext: Reminds the believer of Allah amid worldly trade and earns immense reward.

title: Before Eating or Drinking
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَإِذَا نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
transliteration: Bismillah (and if forgotten at the start: Bismillahi fi awwalihi wa akhirih).
translation: In the name of Allah (or: In the name of Allah at its beginning and at its end).
virtueOrContext: Brings barakah into nourishment and blocks Shaytan from sharing the meal.

title: Praise After Finishing a Meal
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
transliteration: Alhamdulillahilladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.
translation: All praise belongs to Allah Who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power from me.
virtueOrContext: Whoever recites this upon finishing food has their previous minor sins forgiven.

title: Praying for the Host Who Served Food
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
transliteration: Allahumma barik lahum fima razaqtahum waghfir lahum warhamhum.
translation: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided for them, forgive them, and have mercy upon them.
virtueOrContext: Spoken for a family or friend after sharing a meal at their home.

title: Breaking the Fast (Iftar) Sunnah Dua
arabicText: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
transliteration: Dhahabaz-zama'u wabtallatil-'uruqu wa thabatal-ajru in sha'Allah.
translation: Thirst has gone, the veins are quenched, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
virtueOrContext: Authentic Sunnah words recited right after breaking the fast with dates or water.

title: Putting on a New Garment
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu Anta kasawtanihi, as'aluka min khayrihi wa khayri ma suni'a lah, wa a'udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lah.
translation: O Allah, to You be praise; You have clothed me with this. I ask You for its good and the good for which it was made, and seek refuge from its evil.
virtueOrContext: Gratitude when wearing newly bought clothes.

title: Before Entering the Restroom
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
transliteration: Bismillah. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khaba'ith.
translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female unclean spirits.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 142 • Sahih Muslim 375 • Hisn al-Muslim 10
virtueOrContext: Recited before entering the washroom for spiritual modesty and shielding.

title: Upon Exiting the Restroom (Ghufranak)
arabicText: غُفْرَانَكَ
transliteration: Ghufranak.
translation: I seek Your forgiveness, O Allah.
virtueOrContext: Spoken upon stepping out with the right foot, thanking Allah for bodily relief and asking spiritual forgiveness.

title: Before Performing Wudu (Ablution)
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillah.
translation: In the name of Allah.
virtueOrContext: Initiates ablution cleanly before washing hands and face.

title: Upon Completing Wudu (Shahadah & Purity)
arabicText: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
transliteration: Ashhadu alla ilaha illAllahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa Rasuluh. Allahummaj'alni minat-tawwabina waj'alni minal-mutatahhirin.
translation: I bear witness there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone without partner, and Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah, make me among those who repent and purify themselves.
reference: Sahih Muslim 234 • Jami' at-Tirmidhi 55 • Hisn al-Muslim 13-14
virtueOrContext: Opens all eight gates of Paradise for the one who recites it after complete Wudu.

title: When Rain Falls — Seeking Beneficial Provision
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a.
translation: O Allah, make it a beneficial, pouring rain.
virtueOrContext: Moments of rainfall are times when supplications are readily accepted by Allah.

title: Mercy & Pardon for Parents (Quranic Prayer)
arabicText: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
transliteration: Rabbirhamhuma kama rabbayani saghira.
translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them both just as they raised and nurtured me when I was small.
virtueOrContext: Commanded directly by Allah as continual honor and devotion toward mother and father.

title: Righteous Spouse & Offspring as Comfort of Eyes
arabicText: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama.
translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us leaders for the righteous.
virtueOrContext: Signature supplication of the Servants of the Most Merciful ('Ibadur-Rahman).

title: Prophet Ibrahim's Prayer for Steadfast Salah in Offspring
arabicText: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
transliteration: Rabbij'alni muqimas-salati wa min dhurriyyati, Rabbana wa taqabbal du'a'. Rabbanaghfir li wa liwalidayya wa lil-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab.
translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and from my descendants. Our Lord, accept my supplication. Forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day the account is established.
virtueOrContext: Unites consistency in prayer across generations with forgiveness for parents.

title: Seeking Pure & Blessed Offspring (Prophet Zakariyya)
arabicText: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka Sami'ud-du'a'.
translation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself righteous, pure offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.
virtueOrContext: Spoken by Prophet Zakariyya and answered swiftly with the glad tidings of Yahya.

title: Prayer for Righteous Children (Rabbi Hab Li Min as-Salihin)
arabicText: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi hab li minas-salihin.
translation: My Lord, grant me a righteous child from among the upright.
virtueOrContext: Prophet Ibrahim's heartfelt plea for righteous children.

title: Protecting Children From Shaytan & Harmful Eyes
arabicText: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
transliteration: U'idhukuma bikalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammah, wa min kulli aynin lammah.
translation: I seek protection for you in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous pest, and from every harmful evil eye.
virtueOrContext: How the Prophet sought daily protection for Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn, just as Prophet Ibrahim did for Ismail and Ishaq.

title: Blessing Newlyweds on Marriage (BarakAllahu Lakuma)
arabicText: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
transliteration: BarakAllahu laka wa baraka alayka wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayr.
translation: May Allah bless you, shower His blessings upon you, and unite you both in goodness.
virtueOrContext: Prophetic blessing conveyed to newly married couples.

title: Gratitude, Obedience & Righteousness Upon Maturity
arabicText: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي
transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakallati an'amta alayya wa ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu wa aslih li fi dhurriyyati.
translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You bestowed upon me and my parents, to work righteousness pleasing to You, and make righteous for me my offspring.
virtueOrContext: Encouraged especially upon reaching full maturity (40 years) and throughout family life.

title: Supplicating When Visiting or Welcoming a Newborn
arabicText: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ
transliteration: BarakAllahu laka fil-mawhubi lak, wa shakar-tal-Wahib, wa balagha ashuddahu wa ruziqta birrah.
translation: May Allah bless you in what He has gifted you; may you be grateful to the Giver, may the child reach maturity, and may you be blessed with their filial devotion.
reference: al-Adhkar of an-Nawawi • Classical Sunnah Blessing
virtueOrContext: Traditional Islamic blessing shared with new parents.

title: Asking Allah for Love Between Hearts in the Household
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ
transliteration: Allahumma allif bayna qulubina wa aslih dhata baynina wahdina subulas-salam.
translation: O Allah, unite our hearts in affection, mend our mutual relations, and guide us to the paths of peace.
virtueOrContext: Restores warmth, harmony, and reconciliation among spouses, parents, and siblings.

title: Refuge in Allah's Perfect Words in Any Place
arabicText: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
virtueOrContext: Whoever recites this when stopping at any place will not be harmed until they depart.

title: Shield of Bismillah Against Earthly & Heavenly Harm
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa Huwas-Sami'ul-Alim.
translation: In the name of Allah, with Whose name nothing in the earth or in the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
virtueOrContext: Recited three times morning and evening; nothing sudden will harm the believer.

title: Refuge From Sudden Death, Collapse & Fire
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ التَّرَدِّي وَالْهَدْمِ وَالْغَرَقِ وَالْحَرَقِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ يَتَخَبَّطَنِي الشَّيْطَانُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minat-taraddi wal-hadmi wal-gharaqi wal-haraq, wa a'udhu bika an yatakhabbatanish-Shaytanu indal-mawt.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from falling from heights, being crushed under collapse, drowning, and burning, and from Shaytan troubling me at the moment of death.
virtueOrContext: Comprehensive Prophetic protection from catastrophic accidents and an evil end.

title: Refuge From Loss of Blessings & Sudden Wrath
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min zawali ni'matika wa tahawwuli afiyatika wa fuja'ati niqmatika wa jami'i sakhatik.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the removal of Your blessing, the shifting of Your well-being, Your sudden retribution, and all of Your displeasure.
virtueOrContext: Guards gratitude, health, and continuity of Allah's favors.

title: Refuge From Laziness, Senility & Trial of the Grave
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-ajzi wal-kasali wal-jubni wal-harami wal-bukhl, wa a'udhu bika min adhabil-qabri wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from helplessness, laziness, cowardice, senility, and stinginess, and from the punishment of the grave and trials of life and death.
virtueOrContext: Protects energy and resilience throughout youth, old age, and the Hereafter.

title: Refuge From Useless Knowledge & Unanswered Dua
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min ilmin la yanfa', wa min qalbin la yakhsha', wa min nafsin la tashba', wa min da'watin la yustajabu laha.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that brings no benefit, a heart that lacks humility, a soul never satisfied, and a prayer left unanswered.
virtueOrContext: Recited by the Prophet to keep learning, worship, contentment, and supplication sincere.

title: Protection Against Oppressors & Hostile Threats
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
transliteration: Allahumma inna naj'aluka fi nuhurihim wa na'udhu bika min shururihim.
translation: O Allah, we place You before them to restrain them, and we seek refuge in You from their evils.
virtueOrContext: Recited by the Prophet when fearing aggression from a group or unjust authority.

title: When Hearing Thunder
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
transliteration: Subhanalladhi yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihi wal-mala'ikatu min khifatih.
translation: Glory be to Him Whom the thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels out of awe of Him.
virtueOrContext: Said by Abdullah ibn az-Zubayr (RA) whenever he heard thunder.

title: When Fierce Wind Blows
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha wa a'udhu bika min sharriha.
translation: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of this wind, and seek refuge in You from its evil.
reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 5099 (Sahih) • Sahih Muslim 899 • Hisn al-Muslim 163
virtueOrContext: Instead of cursing the wind or weather, turn directly to its Creator for safety and mercy.

title: Entrusting Travelers to Allah (Wada')
arabicText: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
transliteration: Astawdi'ullaha dinaka wa amanataka wa khawatima amalik.
translation: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trusts and family, and the final outcomes of your deeds.
virtueOrContext: What the Prophet said when bidding farewell to any companion setting out on a journey.

title: Freedom From Unlawful Wealth & Heavy Debt (Ali's Dua)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
transliteration: Allahummakfini bihalalika an haramik, wa aghnini bifadlika amman siwak.
translation: O Allah, suffice me with Your lawful provision against Your unlawful, and enrich me by Your grace so I need none beside You.
virtueOrContext: Taught by Ali (RA) from the Prophet: even if debt were like Mount Sabir, Allah enables repayment.

title: After Fajr Prayer — Useful Knowledge & Halal Rizq
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka ilman nafi'a, wa rizqan tayyiba, wa amalan mutaqabbala.
translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, wholesome pure provision, and deeds that are accepted.
virtueOrContext: Recited every morning right after completing the Dawn (Fajr) prayer.

title: Forgive Me, Guide Me, Grant Me Health & Rizq
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
transliteration: Allahummaghfir li warhamni wahdini wa afini warzuqni.
translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being, and provide for me.
virtueOrContext: The Prophet stated these five words encompass all the good of both this world and the Next.

title: Seeking Refuge From Debt & Being Overcome by Sin
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-ma'thami wal-maghram.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and from overwhelming debt.
virtueOrContext: Recited frequently at the end of prayer because debt can lead one to break promises.

title: Prophet Musa's Cry for Help & Good Provision
arabicText: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir.
translation: My Lord, indeed I am in dire need of whatever good You send down to me.
virtueOrContext: Spoken by Prophet Musa in exile without home or work; Allah immediately granted him shelter, family, and honorable work.

title: Blessing in Livelihood, Age, Family & Wealth
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالِي وَوَلَدِي وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَنِي
transliteration: Allahumma akthir mali wa waladi wa barik li fima a'taytani.
translation: O Allah, increase my lawful wealth and my children, and place blessing for me in whatever You have granted me.
virtueOrContext: Derived from the Prophet's blessed prayer for Anas ibn Malik (RA).

title: Seeking Barakah When Paying Off a Debt
arabicText: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالْأَدَاءُ
transliteration: BarakAllahu laka fi ahlika wa malik, innama jaza'us-salafil-hamdu wal-ada'.
translation: May Allah bless you in your family and wealth; surely the reward of lending is gratitude and faithful repayment.
virtueOrContext: Spoken to a generous lender when settling a loan.

title: Refuge From Destitution, Scarcity & Disgrace
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْقِلَّةِ وَالذِّلَّةِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-faqri wal-qillati wadh-dhillah, wa a'udhu bika an azlima aw uzlam.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty, scarcity, and humiliation, and seek refuge from wronging others or being wronged.
virtueOrContext: Shields dignity and livelihood against hardship and exploitation.

title: Comprehensive Opening & Rectifying All Life Affairs
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي
transliteration: Allahumma aslih li diniyalladhi huwa ismatu amri, wa aslih li dunyayallati fiha ma'ashi, wa aslih li akhiratillati fiha ma'adi.
translation: O Allah, set right for me my religion which is my safeguard, set right my worldly life wherein is my livelihood, and set right my Hereafter wherein is my return.
virtueOrContext: Places faith, livelihood, and eternal return in harmonious balance.

title: Helping Us Remember, Thank & Worship Excellently
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma a'inni ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni ibadatik.
translation: O Allah, assist me in remembering You, being grateful to You, and worshipping You in excellence.
virtueOrContext: The Prophet held Mu'adh's hand saying 'I love you' and urged him never to omit this after every prayer.

title: Thanking Anyone Who Has Done You a Favor
arabicText: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
transliteration: JazakAllahu khayra.
translation: May Allah reward you with goodness.
virtueOrContext: Whoever says JazakAllahu khayra to a benefactor has given the utmost praise.

title: Two Light Phrases Heavy on the Scales
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil-'Azim.
translation: Glory and praise be to Allah; glory be to Allah the Supreme.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6406 • Sahih Muslim 2694 • Hisn al-Muslim 255
virtueOrContext: Light on the tongue, beloved to the Most Merciful, heavy upon the Balance of Deeds.

title: Words Filling the Heavens and the Earth With Praise
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
transliteration: SubhanAllah, wal-hamdulillah, wa la ilaha illAllah, wAllahu Akbar.
translation: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, none is worthy of worship except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
virtueOrContext: Dearer to the Messenger of Allah than everything the sun rises upon.

title: A Treasure From the Treasures of Paradise
arabicText: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
translation: There is no power and no strength except by Allah.
reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 6384 • Sahih Muslim 2704 • Hisn al-Muslim 258
virtueOrContext: Described by the Prophet as a treasure stored beneath the Throne in Paradise.

title: Praise Worthy of Allah's Majesty & Authority
arabicText: يَا رَبِّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِجَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ وَلِعَظِيمِ سُلْطَانِكَ
transliteration: Ya Rabbi lakal-hamdu kama yanbaghi li-jalali wajhika wa li-azimi sultanik.
translation: O my Lord, all praise belongs to You as befits the majesty of Your Countenance and the greatness of Your Sovereignty.
reference: Sunan Ibn Majah 3801 • Classical Tasbih & Praise
virtueOrContext: Expresses awe when words feel too small to thank Allah adequately.

title: Prophet Sulayman's Prayer of Gratitude
arabicText: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakallati an'amta alayya wa ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu wa adkhilni bi-rahmatika fi ibadikas-salihin.
translation: My Lord, inspire me to be grateful for Your favor upon me and my parents, to do good pleasing to You, and admit me by Your mercy among Your righteous servants.
virtueOrContext: Recited by Prophet Sulayman upon blessing and success to keep humility intact.

title: In Good Times & Hard Times Alike
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
transliteration: Alhamdulillahilladhi bi-ni'matihi tatimmus-salihat.
translation: All praise belongs to Allah, by Whose grace all good things are perfected.
virtueOrContext: Spoken by the Prophet upon receiving joyful news or completing a righteous milestone.

title: Goodness in This World & Protection From Fire
arabicText: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhaban-nar.
translation: Our Lord, grant us goodness in this world and goodness in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
virtueOrContext: The supplication the Messenger of Allah recited most frequently.

title: Steadfastness of Heart After Guidance
arabicText: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka Antal-Wahhab.
translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
virtueOrContext: Prayer of those firmly grounded in sacred knowledge.

title: Rabbana Afrigh Alayna Sabran — Prayer for Perseverance
arabicText: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana afrigh alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna alal-qawmil-kafirin.
translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience, make firm our feet, and grant us victory.
virtueOrContext: Recited when facing trials requiring courage and patient endurance.

title: Forgive Forgetfulness & Do Not Burden Beyond Capacity
arabicText: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا
transliteration: Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na, Rabbana wa la tahmil alayna isran kama hamaltahu alalladhina min qablina.
translation: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we forget or err. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us.
virtueOrContext: From the final verses of Surah al-Baqarah to which Allah responds: 'I have done so.'

title: Admitting Wrong & Asking Mercy (Adam & Hawwa's Dua)
arabicText: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa il-lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin.
translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
virtueOrContext: The primordial words of repentance revealed by Allah to Adam (AS).

title: Acceptance of Deeds & Repentance (Ibrahim & Ismail)
arabicText: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka Antas-Sami'ul-Alim, wa tub alayna innaka Antat-Tawwabur-Rahim.
translation: Our Lord, accept from us; indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing. And accept our repentance; indeed You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
virtueOrContext: Spoken by Prophet Ibrahim and Ismail while raising the foundations of the Ka'bah.

title: Purifying Hearts From Malice Toward Believers
arabicText: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا
transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lana wa li-ikhwaninalladhina sabaquna bil-iman, wa la taj'al fi qulubina ghillan lilladhina amanu.
translation: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and put not in our hearts any resentment toward those who believe.
virtueOrContext: Cultivates brotherhood, clean hearts, and love for past and present believers.

title: Complete Light & Forgiveness (Rabbana Atmim Lana Nurana)
arabicText: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: Rabbana atmim lana nurana waghfir lana innaka ala kulli shay'in qadir.
translation: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
virtueOrContext: Supplication of sincere believers on the Day of Judgment seeking perfected light.

title: Rabbana Atina Min Ladunka Rahmah — Cave Youths' Dua
arabicText: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
transliteration: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashada.
translation: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
virtueOrContext: Plea of the Companions of the Cave when seeking protection of their faith and clear direction.
